import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

print("Loading training data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
print(f"Training data shape: {train.shape}")

print("Loading test data...")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
print(f"Test data shape: {test.shape}")

sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")

# Sample training data to make training feasible within time limits
print("Sampling training data...")
n_samples = min(500000, len(train))
train_sample = train.sample(n=n_samples, random_state=42)
print(f"Using {len(train_sample)} rows for training")


# Create distance feature (Euclidean distance between pickup and dropoff)
# Handle NaN values by filling with 0
def calculate_distance(row):
    lat_diff = row["dropoff_latitude"] - row["pickup_latitude"]
    lon_diff = row["dropoff_longitude"] - row["pickup_longitude"]
    # Use np.nan to skip, but fillna(0) will handle NaN after
    return np.sqrt(lat_diff**2 + lon_diff**2)


# Apply distance calculation and handle NaN values
train_sample["distance"] = train_sample.apply(calculate_distance, axis=1).fillna(0)
test["distance"] = test.apply(calculate_distance, axis=1).fillna(0)

print("Extracting time features...")


def extract_time_features(df):
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"])
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["day_of_week"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year
    return df


train_sample = extract_time_features(train_sample.copy())
test = extract_time_features(test.copy())

print("Handling passenger_count edge cases...")
train_sample["passenger_count"] = train_sample["passenger_count"].replace(0, 1)
test["passenger_count"] = test["passenger_count"].replace(0, 1)

# Select features
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "distance",
    "hour",
    "day_of_week",
    "month",
    "year",
    "passenger_count",
]

X_train = train_sample[feature_cols].values
y_train = train_sample["fare_amount"].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].values

# Create validation split
print("Creating validation split...")
val_size = int(len(X_train) * 0.1)
val_indices = np.random.choice(len(X_train), size=val_size, replace=False)
train_indices = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(len(X_train)), val_indices)

X_val = X_train[val_indices]
y_val = y_train[val_indices]
X_train_final = X_train[train_indices]
y_train_final = y_train[train_indices]

# Train model - HistGradientBoostingRegressor handles NaN values natively
print("Training model...")
model = HistGradientBoostingRegressor(
    max_iter=200,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=10,
    min_samples_leaf=100,
    random_state=42,
)
model.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

# Validate on hold-out set
print("Validating...")
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, y_val_pred))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Predicting on test set...")
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission with correct format
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test["key"], "fare_amount": test_pred})

# Save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Total predictions: {len(submission)}")
print(f"Final Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")
